title: Sr Linux Engineer
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation. At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD. We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individuals race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD. Responsibilities Oversee installation, configuration, and maintenance of Linux servers across diverse enterprise client environments. Serve as a senior escalation point for P1/P2 client incidents, ensuring timely SLA adherence, technical resolution, and clear communication to clients and internal stakeholders. Proactively maintain and develop all Linux infrastructure technology to deliver 24x7x365 uptime services. Perform system performance management, patching, troubleshooting, upgrades, and lifecycle management to ensure high availability and reliability. Implement and enforce security best practices, vulnerability management, and compliance standards (CIS, NIST, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, or client-specific frameworks). Support incident, change, problem, and request management processes in alignment with ITIL frameworks. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Windows, Network, Security, Cloud) to deliver integrated client solutions. Lead or support client onboarding and migration projects by assessing Linux environments, standardizing configurations, and integrating systems into MSP monitoring and management platforms. Develop and refine SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge base articles to enable repeatable processes across multiple client environments. Implement and optimize monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK), generating reports for internal use and client presentations. Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and act as a role model for best practices. Participate in on-call rotation, including business hours, weeknights, weekends, and holidays. Qualifications Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or similar relevant field. 9+ years of hands-on experience in Linux administration (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian, or similar). In-depth knowledge of Linux systems: installation, configuration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and system hardening. Proven expertise with authentication, authorization, and identity integration: user/group management, SSSD/REALMD, Kerberos, and LDAP/AD. Strong scripting and automation skills in Shell, Perl, Python, and experience with configuration management (Ansible, Puppet, or Chef). Experience with virtualization (VMware, KVM) and exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Solid understanding of security and networking, DNS, NFS, SMTP, HTTP/S, SELINUX, and firewalls within Linux ecosystems. Familiarity with SAN/NAS storage management, LVM, and multipathing. Experience working in ITIL-driven environments with proven SLA accountability. Strong communication and client-facing skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Good to Have Certifications such as RHCE, Linux Foundation Certified Engineer, CompTIA Linux+, or relevant cloud/Linux certifications preferred. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation). Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD). Hands-on knowledge of containerization platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift). Experience using MSP/PSA/RMM tools (ServiceNow, ConnectWise, SolarWinds, Datto, etc.). Capacity planning and cost optimization experience in hybrid or multi-cloud environments. Why AHEAD: Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between. We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning. India Employment Benefits include: Comprehensive health insurance coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents Paid time off and company holidays , along with additional leave benefits as per policy Flexible work arrangements , supporting work-life balance Learning and development opportunities to support continuous growth and upskilling Employee wellness initiatives and programs focused on physical and mental well-being Retirement and statutory benefits in line with India regulations Inclusive and people-first culture , with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

 Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

title: Senior Embedded Networking Engineer
description:
About the role We build and extend firmware for managed industrial Ethernet switches used in factories, utilities, transportation and other environments where the network cannot go down. You will work on the protocol stack at the heart of these switches: how frames are bridged, how loops are prevented, how a ring recovers within milliseconds when a link fails, and how traffic is routed between networks. The role suits a hands-on engineer who has shipped Layer 2 and Layer 3 features on real switch hardware, knows the standards well enough, and can trace a convergence problem from a packet capture down to the switch ASIC. Redundancy work, including Distributed RSTP (DRSTP) and recovery-time optimization, is a core part of the current work. 
 Key responsibilities Design, implement and maintain Layer 2 features on embedded switch platforms: VLANs, MAC learning and ageing, link aggregation (LACP), LLDP, IGMP/MLD snooping, port security and QoS. Own spanning-tree and redundancy features: STP, RSTP and MSTP, Distributed RSTP (DRSTP) and ring coupling, including analyzing and optimizing failover and recovery times. Design, implement and maintain Layer 3 features: static and dynamic routing (OSPF, RIP), ARP and neighbor discovery, VRRP, DHCP relay, IPv4 and IPv6 forwarding, and VRF where the platform supports it. Work across the control plane and data plane: integrate protocol software with the switch silicon through the vendor SDK (Broadcom, Marvell or similar), covering table programming, port and trunk configuration, CPU packet path, hardware events and link-state handling. Debug complex field and lab issues across the stack using packet captures, traffic generators, SDK diagnostics and kernel or system logs; drive root-cause analysis to closure. Write design documents and test plans; review code and designs from other engineers. Work with test teams on protocol conformance, interoperability and performance testing, including convergence-time measurement. Interact directly with customers on technical requirements, feasibility studies and issue resolution. Mentor junior engineers on networking concepts and embedded development practices. 
 Required experience and skills Experience 8 to 10 years of software development on Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking products, with at least 5 years on embedded switch or router platforms. A track record of shipping protocol features into production, not only maintaining them. 
 Layer 2 Strong working knowledge of IEEE 802.1D, 802.1w (RSTP), 802.1s (MSTP), 802.1Q and 802.1AX (LACP), including state machines, timers and edge cases. Hands-on experience with Distributed RSTP (DRSTP) or comparable redundancy schemes (for example multi-chassis link aggregation, IEEE 802.1AX DRNI, MRP/IEC 62439-2 or ERPS/G.8032), including tuning for fast recovery. Experience with LLDP, IGMP/MLD snooping, MAC table management and Layer 2 QoS. 
 Layer 3 Solid knowledge of IPv4 and IPv6 forwarding, ARP and neighbor discovery, static routing and at least one dynamic routing protocol (OSPF preferred). Experience with VRRP and DHCP relay. 
 Control plane and data plane Clear understanding of control plane, data plane and management plane separation on switches and routers, and how protocol state is programmed into hardware forwarding tables. Experience on the control plane: protocol state machines, the CPU packet path (trapping, punting and injecting control frames such as BPDUs, LACPDUs and routing packets), and control-plane policing. Experience on the data plane: programming MAC, VLAN, L3 host and route tables, ACLs and QoS in the ASIC, and handling hardware events such as link changes, table-full and learning events. Ability to debug mismatches between software state and hardware state, and to optimize the path from a control-plane decision to the data plane, which is critical for fast convergence. 
 Embedded and platform Expert C programming in a multi-threaded embedded environment; working knowledge of C++ and scripting (Python or shell). Embedded Linux: cross-compilation, build systems, kernel/user-space interaction, IPC and debugging with gdb and tracing tools. Experience with a switch ASIC SDK (Broadcom, Marvell or similar). Fluent with Wireshark, traffic generators (Ixia, Spirent or similar) and lab test setups. 
 Good to have Experience with industrial Ethernet switch platforms, for example Hirschmann HiOS, Moxa, Siemens SCALANCE or Cisco Industrial Ethernet. Familiarity with industrial redundancy and timing standards: IEC 62439 (MRP, HSR/PRP), IEEE 1588 PTP. Exposure to secure development practices, ideally IEC 62443-4-1/4-2. Management-plane work: CLI, SNMP/MIB design, web management, NETCONF/YANG. Experience connecting devices to cloud management platforms (TLS, MQTT, NATS or WebSockets). Prior customer-facing role in feasibility studies or effort estimation. 
 Interested? Apply here or drop your resume at apin.lal@gadgeon.com

title: MLOps Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a Senior MLOps / ML Engineer to own, develop, and maintain ML deployment and data processing workflows, spanning an Argo-based workflow orchestration platform and Python-based frameworks for large-scale AI model inference. The ideal candidate should have strong Python and problem-solving skills, be comfortable designing and troubleshooting workflows, and be able to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies. A pure MLOps background is not mandatory if the candidate has strong ML/software engineering fundamentals and can work effectively with technologies such as Databricks, Argo, Azure Pipelines, and Ray. 

 Responsibilities 

 Infrastructure Pipeline Development 
 Design and maintain Argo Workflows / Argo Events-based ML and data processing pipelines across environments (dev / QA / staging / prod). Design and maintain WorkflowTemplates, DAGs, fan-out patterns, scheduled workflows, and event-driven triggers following GitOps best practices. Design and develop Python-based workflows and components for ML data processing and model inference. Work with Databricks and Spark-based workloads for data processing, transformation, and pipeline execution. Build and maintain Docker images for ML and GPU-accelerated workloads, including multi-stage builds and container optimization. Develop scalable inference workflows using Ray where required. Integrate with Azure ML and Azure cloud services for model versioning, model artifacts, training workflows, and deployment. Maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, quality gates, and environment-specific deployment processes. 

 Model Deployment Operations 
 Automate deployment, monitoring, and rollback of machine learning and deep learning models on production Kubernetes environments. Manage model versioning and artifact movement from cloud ML workspaces and storage systems to production workloads. Maintain configuration systems and reusable workflow components to ensure reproducible pipeline execution across environments. Monitor model and pipeline performance, data processing health, resource utilization, and infrastructure reliability. Troubleshoot production issues involving failed workflows, data bottlenecks, resource contention, GPU utilization, and latency regressions. Identify reliability and performance issues proactively and implement improvements to ML and data processing workflows. Collaborate with data scientists and engineering teams to improve model deployment, inference, and pipeline reliability. 

 Expertise and Qualifications 

 Must-Have Technical Skills 
 Python - strong programming and problem-solving skills; experience with application development, scripting, and Python packaging. Workflow Design - ability to design reliable workflows with dependencies, parallel execution, retries, failure handling, scheduling, and event-driven execution. Argo Workflows / Argo Events - understanding of WorkflowTemplates, DAGs, event-driven workflows, and workflow execution. Databricks / Data Processing - hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark/Spark SQL, or similar large-scale data processing platforms. Kubernetes - understanding of workload orchestration, resource management, namespaces, and production troubleshooting. Git / Version Control - strong understanding of Git or equivalent version control systems, including branching, merging, pull requests, and maintaining code/configuration changes. Docker - containerization, multi-stage builds, and optimization of ML workloads. CI/CD - experience designing pipelines with automated testing, quality gates, artifact management, and deployment processes. Azure Cloud - working knowledge of Azure ML, Azure Blob Storage, AKS, and Azure-based ML workflows. Problem Solving - ability to troubleshoot unfamiliar technical problems and identify practical solutions. 

 Good-to-Have Technical Skills 
 Ray - distributed data processing and inference at scale. Deep Learning frameworks - PyTorch, TensorFlow; model formats such as ONNX, SavedModel, and TorchScript. Helm / ArgoCD and GitOps-based deployment practices. Prometheus / Grafana and production observability. Experience with Azure Pipelines or similar CI/CD platforms. Experience with ML model monitoring, data drift, and model performance monitoring. Large-scale data processing - experience working with large volumes of structured, unstructured, image, or video data, particularly for ML/AI workloads.

title: Source-to-Pay (STP) Master Data Business Process Analyst
description:
Job Summary 
 Our client, a prominent global healthcare organization, is seeking a Source-to-Pay (STP) Master Data Business Process Analyst to ensure the integrity, compliance, and efficiency of supplier and purchasing master data. In this role, you will design, standardize, and optimize master data processes, focusing on governance, continuous improvement, and risk mitigation. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance data quality, automate workflows, and support transformation initiatives. This position requires a detail-oriented professional with expertise in master data management and a passion for driving operational excellence. The candidate must be able to work in the Clients CEST time zone. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Master Data Governance and Standards: Develop and maintain global standards, policies, and business rules for supplier and purchasing master data; Ensure alignment with compliance, legal, tax, finance, and procurement requirements; Update and maintain process documentation, workflows, and data governance guidelines; Lead efforts to harmonize master data fields, taxonomies, and classification structures. Process Analysis and Optimization: Analyze end-to-end vendor master data processes to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and risks; Implement process improvements to enhance data accuracy, timeliness, and reliability; Benchmark processes against industry best practices and propose optimization strategies; Investigate root causes of data quality issues and lead remediation initiatives. Compliance, Controls, and Risk Management: Strengthen controls around bank details, supplier onboarding, and sensitive data; Partner with Compliance, Internal Controls, and Accounts Payable to ensure adherence to audit requirements; Monitor compliance and address deviations or potential control failures; Support remediation activities from audits or risk assessments. Technology, Systems, and Automation Support: Collaborate with IT and system owners to enhance vendor master data functionality in ERP and procurement systems; Support system upgrades, data migrations, integrations, and testing; Identify automation opportunities and contribute to implementation; Embed data governance principles in technology design. Transformation and Project Support: Contribute to STP transformation initiatives, including supplier onboarding modernization and data quality programs; Support project activities such as requirements gathering, design workshops, testing, and rollout; Track and report benefits of master data improvements (efficiency, quality, compliance). 
 
 Requirements 
 4-7 years of experience in Source-to-Pay (STP), vendor master data management, supplier onboarding, or procurement operations Strong understanding of master data governance, internal controls, and compliance frameworks Knowledge of supplier master data structures, taxonomy, onboarding processes, and risk controls Familiarity with STP processes and cross-functional touchpoints (Procurement, AP, Finance) Ability to identify automation or digitalization opportunities and contribute to technical design discussions Proficiency in data analysis, reporting tools, and root cause analysis Experience with global ERP platforms (SAP, Ariba) and master data management tools (e.g., SAP MDG) Prior involvement in transformation, process improvement, or system enhancement projects 
 
 Skills 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a structured approach Excellent communication skills, able to translate technical details into business language High attention to detail, data accuracy, and quality mindset Ability to drive process improvement initiatives independently Experience working in global or complex organizational environments Familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma or continuous improvement methodologies 
 
 Preferred Qualifications

This position serves as a senior technical writer for technical publications, document architecture, content management, localization, and regulatory documentation requirements. The role collaborates with cross-functional teams including Marketing, RD, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Education, Service, and Manufacturing to ensure documentation supports customer needs, product usability, regulatory compliance, and business objectives. Technical Publication Engineer III provides strategic guidance on content development processes, drives documentation standards and best practices, and manages complex documentation projects across multiple product portfolios. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Provide the planning, development, review, approval, and maintenance of product documentation, including Instructions for Use (IFUs), Operator Manuals, Service Manuals, Installation Guides, Security manuals, System Administration manuals, Data sheets, Release Notes, and Online help systems. Define documentation strategies, content architecture, and information design standards to improve usability and consistency across product lines. Establish and maintain technical writing standards, templates, style guides, and controlled documentation processes. Evaluate and implement best practices for structured authoring, content reuse, and documentation efficiency. Serve as the publication s representative on new product development and sustaining engineering projects. Partner with Engineering, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Quality Assurance, Human Factors Engineering, and Service teams to gather and validate technical information. Provide documentation impact assessments for product changes, design updates, and regulatory submissions. Participate in design reviews, risk management activities, verification and validation reviews, and product launch planning. Ensure documentation complies with applicable regulatory requirements, including FDA, EU MDR, ISO 13485, IEC 62366, and other global medical device regulations. Support regulatory submissions and audit activities by providing documentation expertise and evidence of compliance. Review labeling, safety information, warnings, cautions, and instructions to ensure consistency with regulatory requirements. Supporting the global localization activities and coordinate translation vendors to support worldwide product releases. Define localization strategies and workflows to improve quality, consistency, and delivery timelines. Manage content within document control systems, Quality Management Systems (QMS), Content Management Systems (CMS), and Translation Management Systems (TMS). Manage multiple complex documentation projects with minimal supervision. Develop project schedules, identify risks, and ensure timely delivery of documentation deliverables. Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to documentation tools, workflows, automation, and content development processes. Identify opportunities to improve documentation quality, usability, and operational efficiency. Conduct peer reviews and provide constructive feedback to ensure high-quality content. Promote best practices in technical communication and content development Uphold the company s core values of Integrity, Innovation, Accountability, and Teamwork. Demonstrate behavior consistent with the company s Code of Ethics and Conduct. It is the responsibility of every employee to report to their manager or a member of senior management any quality problems or defects in order for corrective action to be implemented and to avoid recurrence of the problem. Duties may be modified or assigned at any time to meet the needs of the business. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Minimum 8+ years of technical writing experience, preferably within the medical device, healthcare, life sciences, or other regulated industries. Bachelor s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, or related discipline required. Demonstrated experience leading complex technical documentation projects from concept through product release. Experience supporting regulatory compliance and quality system requirements in regulated environments. Expert proficiency with Adobe FrameMaker, InDesign, Photoshop, and Microsoft Office. Strong experience with Structured FrameMaker, XML, DITA, CMS, and TMS platforms. Experience with graphics creation, content reuse strategies, and structured authoring methodologies. Familiarity with software development life cycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and product development processes. Working knowledge of usability engineering, and human factors documentation. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills. Proven ability to influence stakeholders across multiple functional areas. Ability to work independently and make sound decisions with limited supervision. Experience managing external translation and localization vendors

title: Sr Linux Engineer
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation. At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD. We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individuals race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD. Responsibilities Oversee installation, configuration, and maintenance of Linux servers across diverse enterprise client environments. Serve as a senior escalation point for P1/P2 client incidents, ensuring timely SLA adherence, technical resolution, and clear communication to clients and internal stakeholders. Proactively maintain and develop all Linux infrastructure technology to deliver 24x7x365 uptime services. Perform system performance management, patching, troubleshooting, upgrades, and lifecycle management to ensure high availability and reliability. Implement and enforce security best practices, vulnerability management, and compliance standards (CIS, NIST, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, or client-specific frameworks). Support incident, change, problem, and request management processes in alignment with ITIL frameworks. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Windows, Network, Security, Cloud) to deliver integrated client solutions. Lead or support client onboarding and migration projects by assessing Linux environments, standardizing configurations, and integrating systems into MSP monitoring and management platforms. Develop and refine SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge base articles to enable repeatable processes across multiple client environments. Implement and optimize monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK), generating reports for internal use and client presentations. Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and act as a role model for best practices. Participate in on-call rotation, including business hours, weeknights, weekends, and holidays. Qualifications Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or similar relevant field. 9+ years of hands-on experience in Linux administration (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian, or similar). In-depth knowledge of Linux systems: installation, configuration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and system hardening. Proven expertise with authentication, authorization, and identity integration: user/group management, SSSD/REALMD, Kerberos, and LDAP/AD. Strong scripting and automation skills in Shell, Perl, Python, and experience with configuration management (Ansible, Puppet, or Chef). Experience with virtualization (VMware, KVM) and exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Solid understanding of security and networking, DNS, NFS, SMTP, HTTP/S, SELINUX, and firewalls within Linux ecosystems. Familiarity with SAN/NAS storage management, LVM, and multipathing. Experience working in ITIL-driven environments with proven SLA accountability. Strong communication and client-facing skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Good to Have Certifications such as RHCE, Linux Foundation Certified Engineer, CompTIA Linux+, or relevant cloud/Linux certifications preferred. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation). Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD). Hands-on knowledge of containerization platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift). Experience using MSP/PSA/RMM tools (ServiceNow, ConnectWise, SolarWinds, Datto, etc.). Capacity planning and cost optimization experience in hybrid or multi-cloud environments. Why AHEAD: Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between. We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning. India Employment Benefits include: Comprehensive health insurance coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents Paid time off and company holidays , along with additional leave benefits as per policy Flexible work arrangements , supporting work-life balance Learning and development opportunities to support continuous growth and upskilling Employee wellness initiatives and programs focused on physical and mental well-being Retirement and statutory benefits in line with India regulations Inclusive and people-first culture , with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: AI & Workday Product Specialist
description:
Job Description 
 Work Mode: 5 days WFO/Hybrid 

 Position Summary 
 The AI Workday Product Specialist is responsible for supporting the ongoing optimization, governance, and evolution of Workday while developing practical AI-enabled solutions that improve efficiency, reduce manual work, strengthen reporting, and enhance employee experience. This role serves as a key partner in modernizing People Operations by providing Workday product ownership, supporting system enhancements, managing releases, improving reporting and data quality, and identifying opportunities to leverage AI, automation, bots, and agents across People Culture processes. The position combines HR technology expertise, process improvement, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities to help build a scalable, technology-enabled operating model. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 Workday Product Ownership Optimization 
 Serve as a day-to-day Workday product specialist and subject matter resource. Support Workday stabilization, optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives. Assist with configuration, testing, validation, and deployment of system enhancements. Coordinate Workday releases, enhancement requests, and testing activities. Maintain enhancement backlogs and assist in prioritization efforts. Support management of Workday business processes, workflows, approvals, and user experience improvements. Partner with internal stakeholders and external consultants to implement new functionality and capabilities. Identify opportunities to increase adoption and maximize value from the firms Workday investment. 

 Reporting, Analytics Data Governance 
 Develop and maintain Workday reports, dashboards, and metrics. Support workforce analytics, operational reporting, and executive reporting needs. Ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of employee and organizational data. Assist with security audits, data controls, testing protocols, and compliance requirements. Partner with stakeholders to establish meaningful measures of system effectiveness and adoption. Support ongoing reporting enhancements across the employee lifecycle. 

 AI, Automation Digital Enablement 
 Design, build, and maintain approved AI-enabled tools, agents, bots, and automations. Evaluate repetitive People Operations processes for automation opportunities. Develop AI-assisted workflows that improve productivity, service delivery, and employee experience. Create and maintain prompts, workflows, knowledge assets, and governance documentation. Monitor AI solution performance, utilization, controls, and adoption metrics. Partner with business leaders to identify practical AI use cases with measurable business value. Stay current on emerging AI technologies and recommend applications appropriate for People Operations and Total Rewards. 

 Process Improvement Documentation 
 Document current-state and future-state business processes. Support process redesign and standardization initiatives. Develop training materials, user guides, and system documentation. Assist with change-management and adoption activities. Identify process inefficiencies and recommend scalable solutions. Support MA, international expansion, and new capability implementations as needed. 

 Vendor Project Support 
 Coordinate with Workday consultants, implementation partners, and technology vendors. Participate in Workday-related projects, integrations, and future module deployments. Support testing, issue resolution, and project documentation. Assist with roadmap planning and tracking of technology investments and outcomes. 

 Qualifications Required 
 Bachelors degree in Information Systems, Human Resources, Business, Computer Science, or related field. 3-5+ years of experience supporting Workday, HRIS, enterprise systems, or digital transformation initiatives. Experience with Workday reporting, business processes, testing, and system administration. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent organizational and documentation abilities. Experience working with automation platforms, workflow tools, or low-code solutions. Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 

 Preferred 
 Knowledge of AI, generative AI, agents, copilots, automation platforms, or robotic process automation. Experience with Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, or similar technologies. Experience in professional services, consulting, or private-equity-backed organizations. 

 Success Measures 
 Success in this role will be measured by: Increased Workday adoption and utilization. Reduced manual effort through automation and AI-enabled solutions. Improved data quality and reporting effectiveness. Timely delivery of Workday enhancements and releases. Improved employee and manager experience. Strong process documentation and governance. Demonstrated productivity gains, risk reduction, and operational efficiency improvements. Measurable realization of value from Workday and AI investments.

title: QA Engineer - Automation & Manual Testing
description:
Job Description 
 We are looking for a hands-on and detail-oriented QA Engineer / QA Automation Engineer to take complete ownership of product quality across our web application. This role will be responsible for both manual and automation testing, with a strong focus on Frontend/UI and API testing. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or similar automation frameworks, along with good knowledge of APIs, SQL, CI/CD and Agile methodologies. As the first dedicated QA professional, you will have the opportunity to establish QA processes, automation frameworks, testing standards and best practices from the ground up. Key Responsibilities Own the complete QA lifecycle, including test planning, execution, defect management, regression and release validation. Perform functional, integration, system, UAT, regression, smoke and exploratory testing. Design, develop and maintain automated test frameworks using Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or similar tools. Determine the appropriate balance between manual and automated testing. Perform Frontend/UI testing across different browsers, devices and screen sizes. Test React/Next.js applications and validate UI functionality and user workflows. Perform API testing using Postman and validate REST APIs, HTTP methods, responses, JSON and integrations. Test end-to-end business workflows involving booking, invoicing, commissions, payments and supplier reconciliation. Validate integrations between frontend, backend services, databases and third-party APIs. Perform data migration, data validation and data parity testing. Review requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria to identify potential quality gaps. Create and maintain test cases, test scenarios, test plans and QA documentation. Identify, reproduce, document and track defects using Jira. Work closely with developers and business stakeholders to resolve defects and improve product quality. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing. Monitor test execution, defect trends and overall product quality. Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives. Establish and improve QA processes, standards and best practices. Independently own quality while collaborating with development and business teams. Required Skills Strong hands-on experience in Manual and Automation Testing. Proven experience building or significantly owning an automation testing framework. Strong knowledge of Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or similar frameworks. Strong experience in Frontend/UI testing. Experience testing React-based applications. Good understanding of API testing, REST APIs, HTTP methods and JSON. Basic to good knowledge of SQL and database testing. Experience testing applications involving multiple services, databases and third-party integrations. Knowledge of Git and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with Jira and defect/test management. Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC and Agile methodologies. Excellent analytical, problem-solving and debugging skills. Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify edge cases and failure scenarios. Ability to work independently and establish QA processes in a fast-paced environment. Good to Have Experience with React / Next.js / TanStack. Experience working in a startup or small development team. Experience as the sole or first QA professional in a team/organization. Exposure to travel technology, fintech, payments or financial applications. Experience testing applications where data accuracy and financial reconciliation are critical. Experience establishing QA automation frameworks and processes from scratch. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a QA Engineer / QA Automation Engineer who: Is strong in both manual and automation testing. Can independently build or significantly own an automation framework. Has hands-on experience with Playwright/Cypress/Selenium. Is comfortable testing Frontend, Backend, APIs and Databases. Can independently take ownership of product quality. Has strong debugging, analytical and problem-solving skills. Can work effectively with developers, product teams and business stakeholders. Note: This is not a purely manual QA role. Strong automation experience and the ability to build or meaningfully own an automation framework are essential.

Reporting to Quality function, you will provide independent quality assurance oversight to ensure engineering and project activities are delivered in compliance with nuclear regulatory requirements, customer commitments, and the CANDU Quality Assurance Program. You will play a key role in strengthening quality culture, driving compliance, managing quality risks, and ensuring the objective evidence, traceability, and governance required to support safe, reliable, and Right First-Time delivery within a highly regulated nuclear environment. Your Role Nuclear Quality Assurance Support the implementation and continual improvement of the CANDU Quality Assurance Program. Ensure compliance with regulatory, customer, project, and management system requirements. Support the development and execution of project Quality Assurance Plans and quality oversight strategies. Provide independent quality assurance support across engineering and project delivery activities. Promote a strong Nuclear Safety Culture and Quality Culture across project teams. Engineering Quality Provide quality assurance oversight of design and engineering processes. Verify compliance with design control, verification, validation, and configuration management requirements. Support quality reviews and assessments of engineering deliverables and records. Identify quality risks and drive timely resolution of quality concerns. Ensure objective evidence is maintained to demonstrate compliance with project and regulatory requirements. Audit, Compliance and Continuous Improvement Conduct audits, surveillances, and compliance assessments. Support customer, regulatory, and third-party inspections. Manage quality findings, non-conformances, and corrective actions through to effective closure. Facilitate root cause analysis and lessons learned activities. Analyse quality trends and identify opportunities to improve performance and reduce risk. Stakeholder Engagement Partner with Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to embed quality requirements throughout the project lifecycle. Provide quality guidance and coaching to project teams and stakeholders. Communicate quality performance, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities to management. About You The successful candidate will demonstrate uncompromising integrity, a strong commitment to Nuclear Safety Culture, and the confidence to provide objective and independent quality assurance oversight, even when faced with challenging project pressures. They will possess exceptional attention to detail, a questioning attitude, and the professional judgement required to identify quality risks, challenge assumptions, and ensure compliance with nuclear quality requirements. The individual will be highly analytical, disciplined, and evidence-driven, with a passion for delivering quality outcomes through rigorous verification, traceability, and continual improvement. Strong interpersonal and influencing skills are essential, enabling them to build trusted relationships with engineering, project, supply chain, and quality teams while promoting accountability, learning, and Right First-Time delivery. Above all, they will be recognised as a dependable quality professional who upholds the highest standards of safety, compliance, and technical excellence in support of global CANDU nuclear projects. Essential Qualifications and Experience Degree in Engineering and Quality Management Experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Nuclear Quality, or other highly regulated industries. Experience implementing and maintaining Quality Management Systems and Quality Assurance Programs. Experience conducting audits, assessments, supplier oversight, or compliance activities. Experience managing non-conformances, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Essential Technical Knowledge Working knowledge of CSA N299 Series CSA N286 ASME NQA-1 ISO 9001 and ISO 19443 Nuclear Safety Culture principles Supplier Quality Assurance Audit and Surveillance Techniques Design Control and Verification Configuration Management Quality Records and Traceability Non-Conformance and Corrective Action Management Working knowledge of Hexagon, AVEVA Smart 3D / E3D, and Siemens NX and domain knowledge of nuclear sector Desirable CQI/IRCA Lead Auditor qualification. ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or equivalent. Experience supporting CANDU, nuclear new build, refurbishment, or life extension projects. Experience as a QA Specialist, QA Engineer, PQAR, CQAR, or equivalent quality role. Lean Six Sigma certification. Experience with digital quality management and reporting tools. Rewards Benefits Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career. This includes: Comprehensive life insurance coverage. Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents. Generous annual leave balance. Flexible and hybrid work solutions. Remote work opportunities outside of country. Company gratuity scheme. Discretionary bonus program. Relocation assistance. Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition. Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make. title: Senior Embedded Networking Engineer
description:
About the role We build and extend firmware for managed industrial Ethernet switches used in factories, utilities, transportation and other environments where the network cannot go down. You will work on the protocol stack at the heart of these switches: how frames are bridged, how loops are prevented, how a ring recovers within milliseconds when a link fails, and how traffic is routed between networks. The role suits a hands-on engineer who has shipped Layer 2 and Layer 3 features on real switch hardware, knows the standards well enough, and can trace a convergence problem from a packet capture down to the switch ASIC. Redundancy work, including Distributed RSTP (DRSTP) and recovery-time optimization, is a core part of the current work. 
 Key responsibilities Design, implement and maintain Layer 2 features on embedded switch platforms: VLANs, MAC learning and ageing, link aggregation (LACP), LLDP, IGMP/MLD snooping, port security and QoS. Own spanning-tree and redundancy features: STP, RSTP and MSTP, Distributed RSTP (DRSTP) and ring coupling, including analyzing and optimizing failover and recovery times. Design, implement and maintain Layer 3 features: static and dynamic routing (OSPF, RIP), ARP and neighbor discovery, VRRP, DHCP relay, IPv4 and IPv6 forwarding, and VRF where the platform supports it. Work across the control plane and data plane: integrate protocol software with the switch silicon through the vendor SDK (Broadcom, Marvell or similar), covering table programming, port and trunk configuration, CPU packet path, hardware events and link-state handling. Debug complex field and lab issues across the stack using packet captures, traffic generators, SDK diagnostics and kernel or system logs; drive root-cause analysis to closure. Write design documents and test plans; review code and designs from other engineers. Work with test teams on protocol conformance, interoperability and performance testing, including convergence-time measurement. Interact directly with customers on technical requirements, feasibility studies and issue resolution. Mentor junior engineers on networking concepts and embedded development practices. 
 Required experience and skills Experience 8 to 10 years of software development on Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking products, with at least 5 years on embedded switch or router platforms. A track record of shipping protocol features into production, not only maintaining them. 
 Layer 2 Strong working knowledge of IEEE 802.1D, 802.1w (RSTP), 802.1s (MSTP), 802.1Q and 802.1AX (LACP), including state machines, timers and edge cases. Hands-on experience with Distributed RSTP (DRSTP) or comparable redundancy schemes (for example multi-chassis link aggregation, IEEE 802.1AX DRNI, MRP/IEC 62439-2 or ERPS/G.8032), including tuning for fast recovery. Experience with LLDP, IGMP/MLD snooping, MAC table management and Layer 2 QoS. 
 Layer 3 Solid knowledge of IPv4 and IPv6 forwarding, ARP and neighbor discovery, static routing and at least one dynamic routing protocol (OSPF preferred). Experience with VRRP and DHCP relay. 
 Control plane and data plane Clear understanding of control plane, data plane and management plane separation on switches and routers, and how protocol state is programmed into hardware forwarding tables. Experience on the control plane: protocol state machines, the CPU packet path (trapping, punting and injecting control frames such as BPDUs, LACPDUs and routing packets), and control-plane policing. Experience on the data plane: programming MAC, VLAN, L3 host and route tables, ACLs and QoS in the ASIC, and handling hardware events such as link changes, table-full and learning events. Ability to debug mismatches between software state and hardware state, and to optimize the path from a control-plane decision to the data plane, which is critical for fast convergence. 
 Embedded and platform Expert C programming in a multi-threaded embedded environment; working knowledge of C++ and scripting (Python or shell). Embedded Linux: cross-compilation, build systems, kernel/user-space interaction, IPC and debugging with gdb and tracing tools. Experience with a switch ASIC SDK (Broadcom, Marvell or similar). Fluent with Wireshark, traffic generators (Ixia, Spirent or similar) and lab test setups. 
 Good to have Experience with industrial Ethernet switch platforms, for example Hirschmann HiOS, Moxa, Siemens SCALANCE or Cisco Industrial Ethernet. Familiarity with industrial redundancy and timing standards: IEC 62439 (MRP, HSR/PRP), IEEE 1588 PTP. Exposure to secure development practices, ideally IEC 62443-4-1/4-2. Management-plane work: CLI, SNMP/MIB design, web management, NETCONF/YANG. Experience connecting devices to cloud management platforms (TLS, MQTT, NATS or WebSockets). Prior customer-facing role in feasibility studies or effort estimation. 
 Interested? Apply here or drop your resume at apin.lal@gadgeon.com

title: Senior / Principal Platform Engineer
description:
Senior / Principal Platform Engineer Multi-Cloud Infrastructure • Kubernetes • Zero Trust • Agentic Platform Development Role mission | Design, code, secure and evolve cloud-native platforms across Azure, GCP, AWS and hybrid environments. Build platform capabilities with Terraform, Kubernetes, GitOps and software engineeringand actively advance agentic platform development, from AI-assisted design and code creation to reusable agents and tool-integrated engineering workflows. Security, compliance and operational rigor are integral to delivery. Thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like engineering environment with rapid delivery, high ownership, hands-on problem solving and disciplined production quality. What you will build Design and implement reusable Terraform modules, cloud landing-zone components, provisioning and lifecycle workflows across Azure, GCP and AWS; engineer resilient multi-region and dedicated-instance patterns. Build and maintain production Kubernetes foundations: clusters, node pools, networking, autoscaling, storage, workload identity, capacity, upgrades and recovery. Develop GitOps delivery platforms using Argo CD, Helm, GitHub Actions and automated validation, promotion, rollback and drift detection. Own platform services and their integration: Istio/service mesh, Keycloak/OIDC, cert-manager/PKI, API gateways, ingress/egress, DNS, secrets management and cloud-native networking. Engineer private networking, routing, firewall policy, WAF, VPN/private interconnect, TLS/mTLS, segmentation, load balancing and end-to-end connectivity troubleshooting. Codify zero-trust and least-privilege controls across identities, workloads, environments, networks, secrets, administrative access and service-to-service communication. Design and automate technical safeguards, traceable changes, evidence capture, continuous monitoring, vulnerability response and environment separation supporting FedRAMP, PCI DSS and SOC 2 requirements. Partner with GRC/Security to map implementations to applicable control obligations; do not equate platform features with certification or authorization. Engineer the observability stack end to end using Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Thanos, Grafana Alloy and OpenTelemetry: metrics collection, long-term retention, centralized logs, alerting, dashboards, telemetry pipelines, capacity signals and incident diagnostics. Deploy, scale, tune, secure and troubleshoot stateful platform componentsincluding Kafka, Redis, relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MariaDB) and document databases (e.g., MongoDB)—covering operators, persistence, replication, backup/restore, upgrades, availability, throughput and recovery. Own secure API gateway and ingress architecture: authentication and authorization, TLS termination, rate limiting, routing, API lifecycle integration, firewall/WAF policy, and service-mesh connectivity. Develop platform tooling in Python, Go or Bash; eliminate recurring operational toil with durable engineering fixes and self-service capabilities. Develop and integrate agentic platform-development capabilities—not just production-operations agents—including AI-assisted Terraform/module and Helm/chart authoring, platform API and controller development, architecture analysis, code review, test generation, infrastructure-plan validation, safe change proposals, developer-facing tools, and reusable agent workflows integrated with GitOps/CI/CD. Use and extend agentic development workflows across the full engineering lifecycle—architecture exploration, Terraform/Helm authoring, code reviews, automated tests, environment validation, pull requests and release readiness—not only production diagnosis and remediation. 


 Required experience 8+ years in software, cloud, DevOps/SRE or platform engineering, with substantial hands-on design and implementation. Advanced Terraform and Kubernetes skills; production experience with Argo CD, GitOps, Helm and CI/CD. Deep experience with Azure plus GCP or AWS; ability to transfer architecture patterns across cloud providers. Strong Linux, networking, DNS, TLS, PKI, routing, firewall, IAM/RBAC and distributed-system troubleshooting. Hands-on with several platform components such as Istio, Keycloak, cert-manager, API gateways and secrets management, with ability to learn the others. Practical deployment, scaling, hardening and operational troubleshooting of Kafka, Redis and relational/document databases in Kubernetes or managed cloud services; experience with API gateways and secure API exposure. Hands-on experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Thanos, Grafana Alloy or equivalent metrics/logging pipelines, including cardinality, retention, alert quality and production troubleshooting. Demonstrated experience implementing security controls in regulated environments and supporting FedRAMP, PCI DSS, SOC 2 or comparably rigorous programs. Coding ability in Python, Go or equivalent; evidence of shipping automation and reusable engineering components. Ability to reason from application behavior through cluster, identity, certificate, network and cloud dependencies. Demonstrated ownership in a fast-paced, startup-like environment: rapid iteration, shifting priorities, independently driving work to production and balancing speed with security and reliability. 

 Preferred Multi-tenant or customer-dedicated SaaS, hybrid/air-gapped architectures, Kubernetes operators/CRDs, cloud cost management. Compliance-as-code, automated audit evidence, policy engines, vulnerability scanning and supply-chain security. Hands-on experience building or extending agentic development workflows, agent tool integrations or shared engineering capabilities for infrastructure and Kubernetes—not only using AI coding assistants. 
 Success in the first 6–12 months Deliver reusable cloud/Kubernetes capabilities that reduce custom environment work and deployment variability. Remove material gaps in security posture and make evidence collection and drift detection more repeatable. Improve deployment safety, platform upgradeability and production diagnostics with measurable outcomes. Build or substantially improve deployment, resilience, scaling and observability for Kafka, Redis, relational and document databases and gateway services; reduce operational bottlenecks. Build and share agentic platform-development workflows that help engineers design, implement, test and evolve secure infrastructure faster, with measurable quality and review controls. Leveling | Senior: independently owns significant subsystems and implementations. Principal: sets cross-platform architecture and standards, resolves cross-domain design decisions and mentors multiple teams.

description:
Dear Job Seekers, Greeting from ACL Digital We are hiring for Integration Telco Data Centre for Gurgaon Location. 
 Greetings from ACL Digital! We are hiring for Integration Telco Data Centre for our Gurgaon client location. Job Title: Data Centre Network Engineer Location: Gurgaon / Manesar (Client Location) Experience: 5-15 Years Notice Period: Immediate to 60 Days(Immediate joiners will be preferred first) Work Mode: Work from office. About the Role: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Center Network Engineer to join our team at our client location in Gurgaon. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in data center fabric, underlay/overlay routing, and extensive hands-on experience in designing, implementing, and troubleshooting complex network infrastructures. This role requires a strong command over routing and switching, network virtualization, Leaf-Spine architectures, VXLAN EVPN fabrics, and multi-vendor environments including Cisco (Nexus 7k/9k, ACI, Meraki), Nokia(Alcatel,7750,7705,7250,7205), or SD-WAN solutions. Key Responsibilities: Design, implement, and maintain high-performance data center network infrastructures and Leaf-Spine topologies. Configure, optimize, and troubleshoot core routing protocols ( OSPF, BGP, IS-IS ) across underlay and overlay networks. Deploy, operate, and troubleshoot VXLAN EVPN fabrics, including VTEP encapsulation/decapsulation, ingress replication, and data center interconnects/gateways. Implement and manage MPLS, L2VPN, and L3VPN services across telco data center environments. Manage, configure, and maintain Cisco Nexus series switches (7000 & 9000 series) and Cisco ACI fabrics. Support integration and operations involving Nokia networking gear, Cisco Meraki, or SD-WAN platforms. Perform capacity planning, traffic engineering, and Tier 2/3 escalation support for mission-critical network incidents. Develop detailed low-level designs (LLD), standard operating procedures (SOP), and network architecture documentation. Participate in scheduled maintenance windows and on-call rotations to ensure 24/7 network availability. Required Technical Skills & Competencies: 1. OSPF & Interior Routing (Underlay): OSPF Core Concepts: In-depth knowledge of SPF/Dijkstra algorithm, DR/BDR election process, router priorities, and interface states. Packet & Network Types: Deep understanding of OSPF packet types (Hello, DBD, LSR, LSU, LSAck) and network types (Broadcast, Point-to-Point, Non-Broadcast). LSA & Route Types: Thorough understanding of LSA Types (1 to 7), Intra-area, Inter-area (O IA), and External routes (E1/E2, N1/N2). Area Types & Flooding: Configuration and design of Backbone, Standard, Stub, Totally Stubby, NSSA, and Totally NSSA areas. Adjacency: Clear understanding of OSPF neighbor states (Down, Init, 2-Way, ExStart, Exchange, Loading, Full) and convergence troubleshooting. 2. BGP & Border Routing: BGP Fundamentals: Strong knowledge of BGP states, synchronization rules, message types (Open, Update, Notification, Keepalive), and finite state machine (FSM). eBGP vs. iBGP: Core architectural differences, split-horizon rules, next-hop processing, and TTL handling. Path Attributes & Best Path Selection: Granular understanding of Weight, Local Preference, AS-Path, Origin, MED, eBGP over iBGP, IGP metric, and tie-breaking algorithms. Scaling & Route Reflection: Practical experience with BGP Route Reflectors (RR), Cluster-ID, originator ID, and loop-prevention mechanisms. 3. Data Center Fabric, VXLAN & EVPN: Fabric Architecture: Deep understanding of 2-Tier/3-Tier Clos Leaf and Spine physical topologies, ECMP routing, and non-blocking fabric designs. VXLAN Fundamentals: Data-plane encapsulation/decapsulation, VNI (Layer 2 & Layer 3), UDP port 4789, and VTEP functionalities. VXLAN EVPN Control Plane: MP-BGP EVPN address family, NLRI route distribution (Route Type 1 to 5), and MAC-to-IP learning without data-plane flooding. Data Center Gateways & VPNs: Inter-subnet routing, Anycast Gateways, DCI (Data Center Interconnect), and operational differences between L2VPN vs. L3VPN architectures. 4. Hardware & Platforms: Cisco Ecosystem: Nexus 7000, 9000 series (NX-OS), Cisco ACI (APIC controller, EPGs, contracts, bridge domains), and Meraki. Alternative Vendor Platforms: Hands-on experience with Nokia Service Routers (SR OS) or SD-WAN solutions is highly preferred. Operational Readiness: Strong background in Tier 2/Tier 3 troubleshooting, packet captures, and high-availability design (VPC, LACP, BFD). Education & Experience: Experience: 5 to 15 years of solid, relevant networking experience in Telco/Enterprise Data Centers. Education: B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA / Diploma in Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or equivalent. 10+2+3(total 15 years education must be required) H rtifications (Preferred): CCNP (Data Center / Enterprise / SP), CCIE, or Nokia NRS I/II certifications will be an added advantage.H
